KKA0330-CLPB30.lead: A washable cotton bag for everyday piping.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Cloth Piping Bag in the 30cm size is a cone of cotton cloth, 30cm from the wide end to the tip and 17cm across the opening. It is the shorter of the two sizes in this listing and sits comfortably in one hand for short, repeated piping runs.

The listing photos show it piping yellow rosettes into a cavity baking tray. Cloth is washed and used again instead of being thrown away, so one bag can stay at the pastry bench for daily biscuit, choux or mashed-potato work.
b: Size: 30cm long with a 17cm-wide mouth.
Material: Cotton cloth body with a small fabric loop at the wide end for hanging.
Reusable: Rinse, dry and fill it again the next day, with nothing to bin after each batch.
KKA0330-CLPB30.suit: Piping cookie dough, choux paste, whipped cream and mashed-potato rosettes in small bakeries and café kitchens.
KKA0330-CLPB30.care: Turn the bag inside out after the shift, wash away cream and batter in warm soapy water, rinse and hang it by the loop until fully dry before storing.
KKA0330-CLPB30.title: Reusable Cotton Cloth Piping Bag 30cm
KKA0330-CLPB30.meta: Kitchenary Kart cloth piping bag, 30cm long with a 17cm mouth. Washable cotton with a hanging loop, for daily piping of cookie dough, cream and mash.

KKA0331-CLPB35.lead: The longer size, for fewer refills during long runs.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Cloth Piping Bag, 35cm option, is cut from cotton cloth to a 35cm length with a 20cm opening, the larger of the two sizes sold under this listing. The extra length takes a bigger scoop per fill when you are working through a full tray.

Photos show the cone printed with its size code and a loop tab at the top edge, and in use piping dough rosettes into a baking tray. It is a good fit for bakers who would rather wash one cloth bag than throw away plastic ones during long piping sessions.
b: Size: 35cm long, 20cm across the open end.
Material: Cotton cloth body with a small fabric loop at the wide end for hanging.
Capacity: The longer cone holds more cream or dough than the 30cm size, so a batch runs with fewer stops.
KKA0331-CLPB35.suit: Large batches of butter-cookie dough, éclair and choux paste, meringue and savoury mash in hotel pastry sections and bakeries.
KKA0331-CLPB35.care: Turn the bag inside out after the shift, wash away cream and batter in warm soapy water, rinse and hang it by the loop until fully dry before storing.
KKA0331-CLPB35.title: Cloth Piping Bag 35cm, Washable Cotton
KKA0331-CLPB35.meta: The 35cm cotton cloth piping bag from Kitchenary Kart has a 20cm mouth and hanging loop, and is washed and reused for long bakery piping runs.

KKA0332-PDPBS.lead: Throwaway bags for quick, clean piping jobs.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Disposable Piping Bag in Small is a clear plastic cone about 30cm along its longest edge and 17cm across the top. Each bag goes in the bin after the job, so there is no washing or drying of bags at the end of service.
Pictured with a metal nozzle fitted, the bag pipes cream borders onto a cake. The Small size handles modest amounts of icing, ganache or cream cheese for cupcakes, pastry tops and dessert plates.
b: Size: Roughly 30cm long and 17cm wide at the opening, the smallest of the three sizes.
Material: Thin clear plastic with red printing, made to be used once and thrown away.
Nozzle Fit: Cut the tip and drop in a metal nozzle, as the photos show, or pipe straight from a narrow snip.
KKA0332-PDPBS.suit: Cupcake swirls, small cake borders, dots on dessert plates and filling doughnuts or éclairs in cafés and cloud kitchens.
KKA0332-PDPBS.care: Single use only: throw the bag away once the filling is piped, and keep unused stock sealed in a clean, dry drawer away from heat.

KKA0332-PDPBS.meta: Kitchenary Kart small disposable piping bags in clear plastic, about 30cm long with a 17cm top. Fit a nozzle, pipe, then bin the bag with no washing.

In its photos, the red-printed bag decorates the rim of a cream cake through a metal nozzle. Medium is the everyday size on many bakery counters: big enough for a full cake of borders, small enough to control comfortably.

It is shown piping cream dots onto a plate and finishing a cake through a metal nozzle. Because each one is binned after the job, busy kitchens skip the washing and drying that reusable bags need.

KKA0335-SPBS.meta: Kitchenary Kart small reusable silicone piping bag, 30cm sides with a 17.5cm top, packed singly. Wash, dry and reuse it for cupcakes and borders.

KKA0336-SPBM.meta: Medium silicone piping bag by Kitchenary Kart: 35cm sides, 19cm opening, one bag per cover pack. Reusable for cakes, cream fillings and mash.

KKA0337-SPBB.meta: Kitchenary Kart large silicone piping bag, 40cm sides with a 22cm top, packed singly. Washable and reusable for bulk frosting and choux piping.

KKA0025-SSBR27.suit: Basting steaks, chicken and fish in the pan, oiling garlic bread, spreading ghee on rotis and brushing sauces in restaurant and hotel kitchens.
KKA0025-SSBR27.care: Wash the bristles and shaft after each use and wipe dry with a cloth so the metal does not spot. It can heat up if left resting on a pan rim.
